WORLD: The whole earth and everyone who lives on it.
SUN: The bright star that gives us daylight.
MOON: It shines in the night sky and travels around the earth.
PLANTS: Grass, flowers and trees are all examples of these.
REST: To stop working and be still. God did this on the seventh day.
SNAKE: A long animal with no legs that spoke to Eve in the garden.
BUILDERS: People who make houses, towers and walls.
SARAH: Abraham’s wife, who laughed when she heard she would have a baby.
PROMISE: When someone says they will surely do something. God keeps every one.
FAMILY: Parents, children, brothers and sisters living together.
FAITH: Trusting God even when you cannot see him.
GRAIN: Wheat or barley. Joseph stored plenty of it in Egypt.
SHEPHERD: A person who takes care of sheep.
STAFF: A long wooden stick for walking or guiding sheep.
TABLETS: Flat stones that God’s commandments were written on.
GIANT: Goliath was a very big, tall one.
COURAGE: Being brave even when you feel afraid.
WINDOW: Daniel opened this toward Jerusalem to pray.
MANGER: The feeding box where baby Jesus was laid.
STAR: The bright light in the sky that led the wise men.
WISEMEN: Travelers from the east who brought gifts to baby Jesus (two words).
MAGI: Another name for the wise men from the east.
DISCIPLES: The twelve friends who followed Jesus.
CROWD: A large group of people gathered together.
TRAVELER: A person on a journey, like the man the Samaritan helped.
ROAD: A way for people to travel along, like the one to Jericho.
DONKEY: A gray animal with long ears that Jesus rode into Jerusalem.
KINDNESS: Being gentle, caring and helpful to others.
HELP: To do something useful for someone who needs it.
INHERITANCE: Money or things a father gives to his children.
FARCOUNTRY: Where the younger son traveled after leaving home (two words).
FEAST: A big special meal with lots of food.
FORGIVENESS: Choosing not to stay angry when someone has wronged you.
BLESS: To ask God to do good things for someone.
WELCOME: To greet someone gladly when they arrive.
LOVE: Caring deeply for someone. God is this.
REMEMBER: To keep something in your mind. Jesus asked his friends to do this.
ALIVE: Living, not dead. Jesus is this again.
GARDEN: A place where plants grow, where Mary met Jesus on Easter morning.
GIVING: Handing something to someone as a gift.
CARE: To look after someone and watch over them.
FRIEND: Someone you like and enjoy being with.
NEIGHBOR: A person who lives close to you.
SHARE: To let others have some of what you have.
FORGIVE: To stop being angry at someone who hurt you.
MERCY: Kindness shown to someone who doesn’t deserve it.
GRACE: A free gift of love that we do not earn.
HEART: The part of you that pumps blood, and the place we picture love.
PEACE: A calm, quiet feeling with no fighting.
BRAVE: Not letting fear stop you from doing what is right.
FEAR: The scared feeling when you think something is dangerous.
LISTEN: To pay attention to what you hear.
COMMANDS: Rules that God gives us to follow.
FOLLOW: To go after someone and do what they do.
THANKS: Words you say when you are grateful.
PRAISE: Words that tell how great someone is.
HOPE: Looking forward with trust that good things will come.
PATH: A narrow way to walk along.
GOODNESS: Being kind and doing what is right.
GRATEFUL: Feeling thankful for what you have received.
FAITHFULNESS: Always keeping your word and staying true.
